learning_outcomes.text: Defines language and knows its properties.
Can define culture and explain its relationship with language.
Classify the world languages and determine the place of Turkish in these languages.
Can analyse the historical periods of Turkish language.
Recognise and explain the historical texts of Turkish language.
Have knowledge about the Turkish Language Association and its studies.
Knows the phonological properties of Turkish.
Knows and can apply the rules of Turkish spelling and punctuation.

syllabus_topics: What is Language? Language-Culture Relationship Types of Language
The Place of Turkish Among the World Languages
Examples from our historical texts (Orkhon Inscriptions, Dîvânü Lugâti't-Türk, Kutadgu Bilig etc.)
assessment_rules: The final success grade is determined by the contribution of in-term activities and the final exam grade. Midterm Examination contributes 40% to the final grade. Final Examination contributes 60% to the final grade.
